# Welcome {.unnumbered}

**Anyone Can Code** teaches you to program by building things. You'll start with small games, then grow one project, a tracker for your games, cards or books, into a real app that saves its data, pulls information from the internet and runs on the web.

You don't need to be good at math. You don't need a fancy computer. If you can follow a recipe and you're willing to be wrong a few times, you can do this.

::: {.callout-important}
## Early draft
This book is being written in the open, and most chapters are still outlines. Follow along, or jump in and help.
:::

## How this book works

Every chapter adds one idea to your toolbox, and you use it right away in a project. The code in each chapter is tested automatically, so if the book says it works, it works.

You'll see a few kinds of boxes along the way:

::: {.callout-note}
## Concept box
Connects what you're learning to software you already use.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Break it on purpose
A bug planted on purpose for you to find and fix. Reading error messages is half of programming.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Level up
A checkpoint listing what you can now explain to someone else.
:::
